name: COVID-19 Outcomes by Vaccination Status - Historical

columns.name: Outcome
columns.description: COVID-19 case, hospitalization, or death.

columns.name: Week End
columns.description: The end date of the week (Sunday-Saturday)

columns.name: Age Group
columns.description: The age group described, in years. Note the presence of an "All" value so care should be taken in summing values.

columns.name: Unvaccinated Rate
columns.description: Rate of the outcome per 100,000 unvaccinated Chicago residents in the age group

columns.name: Vaccinated Rate
columns.description: Rate of the outcome per 100,000 fully vaccinated but not boosted Chicago residents in the age group

columns.name: Boosted Rate
columns.description: Rate of the outcome per 100,000 fully vaccinated and boosted Chicago residents in the age group

columns.name: Crude Vaccinated Ratio
columns.description: Crude incidence rate ratio  (unvaccinated rate : vaccinated rate).

columns.name: Crude Boosted Ratio
columns.description: Crude incidence rate ratio (unvaccinated rate : boosted rate).

columns.name: Age-Adjusted Unvaccinated Rate
columns.description: Age-adjusted rate of the outcome per 100,000 unvaccinated Chicago residents. Age-adjustment is only calculated for the “All” age group and is blank for all other groups.

columns.name: Age-Adjusted Vaccinated Rate
columns.description: Age-adjusted rate of the outcome per 100,000 fully vaccinated but not boosted Chicago residents. Age-adjustment is only calculated for the “All” age group and is blank for all other groups.

columns.name: Age-Adjusted Boosted Rate
columns.description: Age-adjusted rate of the outcome per 100,000 fully vaccinated and boosted Chicago residents. Age-adjustment is only calculated for the “All” age group and is blank for all other groups.

columns.name: Age-Adjusted Vaccinated Ratio
columns.description: Age-adjusted incidence rate ratio  (age-adjusted unvaccinated rate : age-adjusted vaccinated rate). Age-adjustment is only calculated for the “All” age group and is blank for all other groups.

columns.name: Age-Adjusted Boosted Ratio
columns.description: Age-adjusted incidence rate ratio  (age-adjusted unvaccinated rate : age-adjusted boosted rate). Age-adjustment is only calculated for the “All” age group and is blank for all other groups.

columns.name: Population Unvaccinated
columns.description: Total number of unvaccinated people in the age group.

columns.name: Population Vaccinated
columns.description: Total number of fully vaccinated people in the age group.

columns.name: Population Boosted
columns.description: Total number of boosted people in the age group.

columns.name: Outcome Unvaccinated
columns.description: Total number of unvaccinated people in the age group with the outcome.

columns.name: Outcome Vaccinated
columns.description: Total number of vaccinated people in the age group with the outcome.

columns.name: Outcome Boosted
columns.description: Total number of boosted people in the age group with the outcome.

columns.name: Age Group Min
columns.description: The low end of the age group. This column is used primarily to allow for easier sorting. The "All" age group is set to 999.

columns.name: Age Group Max
columns.description: TO BE HIDDEN: The high end of the age group. This column is used primarily to allow for easier sorting. The All age group is set to 999. The 80+ group is set to 200.
